thread:
Jordan (customer): Hi — I redeemed a promo code via the dashboard this morning, got the confirmation email, but my org balance didn’t change. Can someone check?
Maya (Support): Sorry about that, can you share your org ID and the promo code you used?
Jordan (customer): Org: org_87x3q, code: WINTERTRIAL2026. Email confirmation came at 2026-03-16 09:12 UTC.
Maya (Support): Thanks. I’ll pull ledger events and webhook logs. One sec.
Maya (Support): @Priya billing — FYI org_87x3q claims a promo, email confirmed but balance shows 0. Can you look at grants ingestion?
Priya (Billing): Looking now. Do we have the webhook delivery id or redeem event id?
Maya (Support): I have the dashboard event id: redeem_evt_20260316_142, and the webhook delivery id from our UI: wh_7890.
Leo (SRE): Pinging ingest-bot to fetch the raw webhook payload and ledger entry.
ingest-bot: Retrieved payload wh_7890 -> {"org_id":"org_87x3q","code":"WINTERTRIAL2026","amount_cents":100000,"status":"accepted","ts":"2026-03-16T09:12:34Z"}
Leo (SRE): Webhook was delivered and returned 200 OK to merchant service. However I don’t see a corresponding ledger entry in payments. Running quick query:
```
SELECT * FROM ledger_entries WHERE org_id='org_87x3q' AND reference='redeem_evt_20260316_142';
```
Result: no rows.
Priya (Billing): That suggests ingest acknowledged but ledger write failed. Any errors in ingestion logs?
Leo (SRE): Checking ingest logs for redeem_evt_20260316_142: got transient DB timeout at 09:12:35 UTC, then a retry that succeeded at 09:12:40 but the commit didn’t appear. Possible idempotency mismatch — the retry used a different request_id.
Maya (Support): Is there any mismatch between the grant service and ledger mapping? Could it have been applied to a different account?
Priya (Billing): I checked the mapping table for that redeem event. Looks like the grant record exists in grants table but with status "applied_to_old_org_id" — the org_id column is org_078x (inactive).
Jordan (customer): That’s worrying — we never had org_078x. Is there anything I should do?
Maya (Support): Sorry—this looks like a server-side mapping bug during redeem. We’ll escalate. @Priya can we reassign the grant to org_87x3q and force a ledger credit while we root-cause the mapping issue?
Priya (Billing): We can do a manual fix. I’ll run the safe reassign + ledger insert script, will post the audit IDs here. ETA ~ 30m.
Leo (SRE): For the RCA: I’ll open an incident for idempotency header handling in grant ingestion. Might be an edge case when dashboard retries occur and a stale mapping cache is used.
Maya (Support): Thanks. Jordan, we’ll apply the credit manually and confirm when it shows in the UI. Apologies for the friction.
Priya (Billing): Manual fix started. Running: 
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE grants SET org_id='org_87x3q', updated_by='billing_manual_fix' WHERE id='grant_20260316_142' AND org_id='org_078x';
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (org_id, amount_cents, reference, created_by) VALUES ('org_87x3q', 100000, 'redeem_evt_20260316_142', 'billing_manual_fix');
COMMIT;
```
Priya (Billing): Done. Audit ref: audit_20260316_bf31. Please allow a few seconds for propagation to the console.
Maya (Support): Jordan — I’ve pushed a UI cache purge for your org. Can you refresh and confirm balance?
Jordan (customer): Refreshing… balance now shows $1,000.00. Thanks! :relieved:
Jordan (customer): Two quick Qs — will this happen to other promos? And can you confirm the confirmation email is the single source of truth?
Maya (Support): Good questions — short answers: 1) This was an edge-case during a retry path; we’ll patch to prevent future similar mismatches. 2) Confirmation email means the webhook was accepted but not necessarily that ledger credit posted — we’ll update messaging to be clearer.
Priya (Billing): Filing a follow-up action to add a verification step: only send final "credit applied" emails after ledger write commit. Filed as TICKET-5547.
Leo (SRE): Incident opened: INC-2026-0316. Root cause: idempotency header handling + stale org mapping cache under retry. Fix in progress in grant-service repo, PR #328.
Maya (Support): Closing loop: manual credit applied (audit_20260316_bf31), customer confirmed balance. We'll follow up in the incident with postmortem and timeline.
Jordan (customer): Appreciate the quick help — thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
